command: set -euo pipefail; TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/omega-grid-ingest.XXXXXX); OLLAMA_PID=''; cleanup(){ if [ -n "${OLLAMA_PID:-}" ]; then kill "$OLLAMA_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$OLLAMA_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; rm -rf "$TMP"; }; trap cleanup EXIT; git clone -q --depth 1 --branch omega-grid-unified-ingest-20260913 https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/frankenstein.git "$TMP/repo"; cd "$TMP/repo"; echo HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD); python3 -m py_compile scripts/omega_grid_unified_ingest.py scripts/omega_unified_ingest.py scripts/f2wp1207_grid10_turn_loop.py; python3 scripts/omega_grid_unified_ingest.py selftest; python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_omega_grid_unified_ingest.py; DB=/home/ai-core-node/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db; sqlite3 "$DB" ".backup '$TMP/unified.test.db'"; echo TEST_DB_BYTES=$(stat -c %s "$TMP/unified.test.db"); BEFORE_PRE=$(sqlite3 "$TMP/unified.test.db" "SELECT count(*) FROM mv_prestage_turns;"); export OLLAMA_HOST=127.0.0.1:11435; ollama serve >"$TMP/ollama.log" 2>&1 & OLLAMA_PID=$!; for i in $(seq 1 40); do if ollama list >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi; sleep 0.5; done; ollama list; EPOCH=6deb07282f4641f69316964db8ce3be7; python3 scripts/omega_grid_unified_ingest.py ingest --db "$TMP/unified.test.db" --repo gabriel:ai-core-node:frankenstein="$TMP/repo" --runtime-epoch-id "$EPOCH" --session-id omega-grid-source-scratch-20260913 --compressor ollama --model qwen2.5:0.5b --limit 1 --fail-fast; python3 scripts/omega_grid_unified_ingest.py status --db "$TMP/unified.test.db"; AFTER_PRE=$(sqlite3 "$TMP/unified.test.db" "SELECT count(*) FROM mv_prestage_turns;"); test "$BEFORE_PRE" = "$AFTER_PRE"; sqlite3 -separator '|' "$TMP/unified.test.db" "SELECT owner,machine_id,source_scope,repo,compressor,grid_winner_cell,status FROM f2_grid10_source_ingest ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 1;"; echo OMEGA_GRID_UNIFIED_SCRATCH_PASS=1
